meta_data.base_class: delete a specified <service platform> API key from the team's account, removing its access to the API - these platforms all provide API key management and access control functions.

tool_template.name: delete_<class>_api_key
tool_template.description: Delete a specified <class> platform API key from the team's account, removing its access to the API.

apikey.description: The unique identifier for the <class> platform API key that needs to be deleted.

confirmation_required.description: Indicates whether a confirmation prompt should be shown before deleting the <class> API key.

deletion_reason.description: The reason for deleting the <class> API key, to be logged for audit purposes.

user_id.description: The identifier of the user requesting the deletion of the <class> API key.

notify_team.description: Determines if a notification should be sent to the team upon successful deletion of the <class> API key.
